spec: Standalone GuildArena contract: no ETH, deposits, payable, receive, tokens or approvals; only the Safe can pause. Anyone creates a guild with a bytes32 name; every guild has the same seat cap (8); an address is in at most one guild and may join or leave outside a reveal phase. Epochs are 7 days from deployment; each is a mission: first half, a member commits keccak256(secret, sender, epoch); second half, they reveal it. One valid reveal per member per epoch earns 1 point for the member and 1 for the guild. Guild points are stored per epoch for a leaderboard; member reputation is lifetime points, never decreasing. Views: members, guild points per epoch, reputation, top guild per epoch. Events for create, join, leave, commit, reveal. Invariants: seat cap held, one guild per address, no point without a matching commit, reputation monotone, no reveal outside its phase. (a game build)
